messages.content:
Dear challenge participants,

The submission system to upload your final technical reports is now live:

In order to be eligible for prices, you must submit a technical report to the HASCA workshop hosted at UbiComp/ ISWC. For more details what to contain in the report, check out the Overview tab here on Kaggle.

👉 How to Submit the Report:

  1. Head over to the conference submission platform, PCS (Precision Conference). Log in or create an account.
  2. Go to Submissions - Make a New Submission.
  3. Choose:
  • Society: SIGCHI
  • Conference/Journal: UbiComp/ISWC 2025
  • Track: UbiComp/ISWC 2025 HASCA-WEAR
  1. Click on Go.

👉 Selecting your Final Predictions:

  1. Head over to the WEAR Challenge page on Kaggle
  2. Go to the Submissions tab
  3. Select the submission you want to submit for final scoring. If you do not select anything, Kaggle will automatically have selected the submission which scored highest on the public leaderboard.

🚨 We will select the winners of the challenge based on the private leaderboard score once the submission system closes (July 4th AoE). Make sure you have selected the correct predictions at this point - we will not accept late submissions or changes in predictions. The challenge will continue to be available until the day of the workshop. Feel free to still submit - we will still give out honorable mentions to the private leaderboard winners after submission closed.

📅 Don’t forget to upload your final report by 4th July AoE and adhere to the official conference formatting guidelines. Submissions will be reviewed single-blind (i.e. you don't need to anonymize your report).

For any questions, feel free to reach out to me here or via e-mail (marius.bock(at)uni-siegen.de)! 🚀
